representation: source interaction frame transferred to a target whole-hand grasp frame with bimanual interaction and source-derived ownership semantics
source_interaction_frame: ALOHA model-derived static jaw closing-region frame
target_interaction_frame: G1 active-model-derived three-contact whole-hand enclosure frame

orientation_semantics.policy: G1 shoulder-to-grasp bearing with projected model-up and one static mirrored palm twist; source jaw rotation is diagnostic because the provisional doll is approximately spherical
orientation_semantics.scope: one common ownership-state weighting table for every episode; no Cartesian correction

handoff_cartesian_residual.reason: twice a thumb-pad tangential half-extent is a clearance scalar, not a rigid wrist-to-grasp transform

bimanual_interaction.relative_vector_policy: preserve source-derived interaction-frame relation; weights change by ownership state but Cartesian targets do not
bimanual_interaction.absolute_spacing_policy: no spacing clamp and no phase-specific displacement

hand_mapping: common semantic OPEN/PRESHAPE/GRASP/HOLD/RELEASE mapping shared byte-for-byte with A

hand_primitive_derivation.right_whole_hand: exact active-model mirror of the left thumb/index/middle synergy
hand_primitive_derivation.grasp_frame_center: circumcenter of the thumb/index/middle distal pad-center triangle at the canonical GRASP synergy
hand_primitive_derivation.grasp_frame_axes: X thumb-to-index-middle closing direction; Z middle-to-index spread direction orthogonalized to X; Y=Z cross X
